items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: Allen was interviewed in Scottsdale, Arizona on April 15, 2000, by Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Well thanks Monk. I appreciate your—

ctx.x: What do you envision down the road. Do you think ten years ahead for yourself, and the future of this music?

Well as I said before, Monk, I’m a little concerned about the future of this music and I try not to think about ten years down the road. I try to look at things year by year. If the phone keeps ringing I’m in good shape. And so far, so good. But what happens, in ten © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

years, gee I don’t really know. I am concerned about it. I live in the Orlando area so I worked at Walt Disney World some, sub out there with other bands and stuff like that. What concerns me is I envision myself ending up having to try to get a regular job at Walt Disney World because I can’t make a living any other way. Hopefully not.
